evidence: IMD 0.25° gridded data 1901–2024, public, daily. CDSP portal operational. Comparable to NOAA gauge network.
gap: Real-time data feed API for exchange settlement needed.
recommendation: IMD to develop certified settlement data API (T+1 availability).

evidence: JJAS cumulative index is well-defined. Onset/withdrawal methodology exists (IMD pentad criterion).
gap: No standardised sub-division rainfall index approved by SEBI. Aggregation methodology needs exchange-level specification.
recommendation: SEBI to publish Index Computation Methodology circular specifying IMD grid aggregation rules per approved sub-division.

evidence: Academic models exist (this paper). No exchange-validated pricing model or approved model risk framework.
gap: No SEBI-approved model validation standard for weather derivatives. Burn analysis vs MPP disagreement unresolved.
recommendation: SEBI to mandate dual-method pricing (burn + stochastic) with disclosed model risk spread as minimum bid-ask width.

evidence: Crop insurers (PMFBY), hydro IPPs, agri-commodity trading firms identified as natural participants.
gap: No designated weather risk desk at Indian banks/NBFCs. Limited awareness among potential hedgers.
recommendation: SEBI/IRDAI joint working group on crop insurer participation. RBI to clarify hedging treatment for weather derivatives on bank books.

evidence: SEBI has explored commodity weather derivatives under SC(R)A framework. FMC merger into SEBI (2015) enables commodity + financial derivative integration.
gap: No gazette notification defining 'weather index' as permissible underlying under SCRA. Dispute resolution for index manipulation undefined.
recommendation: MoF/SEBI to gazette weather index as permissible SCRA underlying. Specify IMD as sole authorised index provider.

evidence: No Indian exchange product currently adjusts for climate non-stationarity in pricing or margin.
gap: Static burn analysis will increasingly misprice as monsoon distribution shifts under warming scenarios.
recommendation: SEBI to mandate annual GCM-informed price surface update. IMD to publish official CMIP6-adjusted seasonal probability forecasts.

evidence: No market maker framework for illiquid weather contracts. CME uses designated market makers with mandatory quote obligations.
gap: Without market makers, bid-ask spreads will be prohibitively wide. Price discovery impossible without liquidity providers.
recommendation: SEBI to create DMM (Designated Market Maker) scheme for weather derivatives with inventory hedging exemptions.
